quotes.text: The recorded Thunderbird Phabricator review workflow derives comment locations from the raw unified diff's new-side coordinates. Checkout line numbers can differ from the reviewed patch, so confirm the exact revision and raw diff before writing an anchored comment. This is a review workflow preference, not proof that a finding is valid.
